name: print_areas
label: Print areas

spec.name: points
spec.label: Points
spec.help: Map an array of four [x, y] coordinate pairs in clockwise order.

spec.name: print_area_id
spec.label: Print area ID
spec.help: Id of an existing print area of this mockup to keep its id. Leave it out for a new area.

help: Replace the saved quadrilateral print areas, or send an empty array to remove them. The API decides whether the mockup can remain renderable without saved areas. An area with a print area ID keeps that id.
